caption: The video captures an outdoor, sunlit scene framed against leafy trees and blue sky. A person in a pale shirt extends both arms toward a large pink inflatable ball printed with a yin-yang-style symbol. The right hand lies flat against the ball while the open left hand hangs beneath it. A thin metal wand angles upward from the right, spraying water onto the ball's side. The ball is already inflated and keeps growing across the clip, its diameter and symbol enlarging as its top edge drifts upward toward the top of the frame. The right hand shifts slightly against the stretching surface, the lower hand drifts a little, and the broad mist at the upper right persists alongside a concentrated burst of droplets at the wand tip.
